reportTitle: Phase 7A.6R2 Activation Durability, Operation Serialization & Safe Drain Closure

fixA_ActivationAndRestartRecoveryConsist.description: Comprehensive contract differentiating installed, configured, active, and durability states across startup recovery and live execution.

stateMatrix.freshInstall: active.json absent -> manager defaults to fixture, installed=false, zero network calls, canInstall=true
stateMatrix.corruptMetadata: active.json corrupt/malformed -> manager defaults to fixture, active.json preserved for forensics, recoveryError recorded
stateMatrix.missingDatabase: active.json present but SQLite file missing -> manager defaults to fixture, recoveryError recorded, zero auto-downloads
stateMatrix.corruptDatabase: SQLite file fails schema or probe verification -> manager defaults to fixture, candidate handle closed, recoveryError recorded
stateMatrix.configuredManaged: Valid database and configuredMode='managed-ecdict' -> manager activates managed dictionary, installed=true
stateMatrix.configuredFixtureExplicit: Valid database, configuredMode='fixture', and settings was cleanly synced (settingsSynced=true) -> honors explicit user choice, manager remains on fixture, installedCorpus cached
stateMatrix.configuredFixtureFailedSync: Valid database, configuredMode='fixture', but settings sync previously failed (settingsSynced=false or settingsSyncError present) -> recognizes intentional user activation, reactivates managed dictionary, retries settings sync

fixB_FailedActivationTransactionCompensa.description: Compensation rollback on activation failure without losing prior active metadata or leaking Windows SQLite handles.

mechanisms.priorMetadataPreservation: Captures previousMetadata before activation attempt; if DictionaryManager.activate fails, previousMetadata is atomically restored via writeActiveMetadataAtomically
mechanisms.firstInstallCompensation: If first-time install activation fails, candidate active.json is safely unlinked to prevent false durability claims
mechanisms.sqliteHandleSafety: Candidate DatabaseSync handle is reliably closed in all error branches, preventing Windows file locking (EPERM)
mechanisms.doubleFaultHandling: Throws ActivationRollbackError preserving both original cause and rollback cause when both primary activation and rollback restoration fail

explicitCommitPoints.preCommit: Cancellation during download or building aborts gracefully, unlinks candidate, leaves active database untouched
explicitCommitPoints.inCommit: Pre-commit check right before activateManagedDatabase refuses activation if cancellation or disposal was signalled
explicitCommitPoints.postCommit: Cancellation signal arriving after database activation has committed is settled as completed without corrupting database

fixC_OperationSerialization.description: Strict asynchronous mutex gating preventing concurrent or interleaved execution of install and remove operations.

rules.concurrencyRefusal: Returns 409 OperationInProgressError on concurrent install while install runs, remove while install runs, install while remove runs, or remove while remove runs
rules.promiseBarrier: Awaits settle of previous operation before accepting new operations; remove() claims exclusive lock during execution
rules.recoveryCoordination: Both install and remove handlers await activationCoordinator.ensureReady() before initiating mutations
rules.lifecycleSequentiality: Full install -> remove -> install lifecycle executes sequentially without state pollution

fixD_CordisDisposeTimeoutSafetyAndDrainC.description: Bounded safe drainage of in-flight operations on plugin unload with Cordis dispose timeout safety and quarantine preservation.

guarantees.boundedDrain: Awaits in-flight operation settlement up to timeoutMs; throws OperationDrainTimeoutError on timeout without hanging unload
guarantees.quarantinePreservation: Dispose never unlinks quarantined directories or bypasses quarantine checks; preserves statusUnknown fail-closed state
guarantees.idempotentDispose: Multiple dispose() calls do not re-abort or throw; subsequent install() and remove() calls are rejected immediately
guarantees.aggregateErrorHandling: Host plugin unload aggregates disposal errors across route unregistration, operation manager disposal, and manager closing into AggregateError

verifiedInvariants.unauthenticated401Fence: All 6 routes return 401 when requested anonymously without DSH session
verifiedInvariants.zeroNetworkRequestsOnBoot: Boot and status check make 0 external requests
verifiedInvariants.contentType415: Verified non-JSON content-type rejected with 415 UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE
verifiedInvariants.forbiddenOverrides400: Custom downloadUrl/source parameters rejected with 400 BAD_REQUEST
verifiedInvariants.invalidCancelOperationId400_404: Invalid operationId returns 400; unknown operationId returns 404
verifiedInvariants.concurrencyConflict409: Concurrent install or remove requests return 409 OPERATION_IN_PROGRESS
verifiedInvariants.lookupResponsiveDuringInstall: GET lookup queries remain fully responsive while install runs in background
verifiedInvariants.cancellationSettlement: Cancellation dispatch smoothly transitions operation to 'cancelled'
verifiedInvariants.fullInstallationSettlement: ECDICT imports 770,611 entries, activates into live manager without restart
verifiedInvariants.nonFixtureHitsInEcdict: Probed non-fixture words ('apple', 'hello', 'ephemeral', 'quixotic') hit in ecdict-local
verifiedInvariants.safeRemovalWithWindowsLockRelease: Removal hot-switches to fixture, closes DatabaseSync handle, and unlinks file cleanly
verifiedInvariants.postRemovalReversion: Non-fixture words miss after removal; fixture words continue hitting
